title: Semantic Claude-compatible GLM and DeepSeek providers
content: Bro provider names should remain semantic: use `glm` for the Z.AI Coding Plan API and `deepseek` for the DeepSeek API. Both are Claude Code CLI-backed Anthropic-compatible transports, with credentials/configuration owned by the selected Claude config directory (`~/.claude-zai` and `~/.claude-ds` by default). OpenCode remains available for Inception and future nonstandard provider transports.
